title: What Is Agentic Coding? How AI Agents Are Replacing Pair Programming
summary: Agentic coding means AI reads your codebase, plans changes, writes code, runs tests, and commits — independently. Here's how it works and the tools developers use in 2026.
body_markdown: Autocomplete predicts what you're about to type — it's reactive and single-line. Agentic coding is proactive and multi-step: the agent reads your codebase, plans a complete implementation, writes it across multiple files, runs tests, and iterates until the result is correct. You describe an outcome; the agent figures out how to achieve it.[Blink](https://blink.new/) extends agentic coding further by provisioning infrastructure automatically — your agent doesn't just write code, it deploys it with database, auth, and hosting included.
